text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 23,440.8, up 1.68% for the day and 3.02% over the last five sessions, while the broader Nifty 500 rose 1.58% (5‑day +2.93%). Advances outpaced declines (395 vs 94) giving a breadth score of 44.4 in a neutral zone, indicating the rally was fairly broad‑based. The Bank Nifty added 0.58% to 55,002.2, staying above its 200‑day moving average (56,686.85) but below the pivot resistance (55,871.7).

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹6,836.81 cr today and a 5‑day total of ₹15,309.51 cr, while Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹3,678.85 cr. The FII streak is five buying days, suggesting strong foreign inflow. In options, Nifty’s put‑call‑ratio (PCR) is 1.93, indicating more put interest; the max‑pain level sits at 23,700 and a call wall at 23,850 may cap upside. Bank Nifty’s PCR is 0.97 (near‑balanced) with max‑pain at 55,600 and a symmetric call/put wall at 58,000, hinting at limited movement beyond that.

Watch the 23,362.88 pivot (P) and support at 23,284.97 for Nifty; a break below could test the 23,200 region. For Bank Nifty, the pivot is 54,876.85 with support at 54,707.35. Key headlines to monitor include continued FII buying (record‑high flows) and any RBI policy cues, as well as earnings updates from major banks and commodity‑linked stocks that could influence the next session’s direction.
